description: The provided image displays two line plots comparing the training rewards of two algorithms, "Llama-On-Policy" and "Llama-LUFFY", across two different training set difficulties: "Easy" and "Hard". Both plots share the same axes: the x-axis is labeled "Steps" and ranges from 0 to 500 with tick marks at intervals of 100, while the y-axis is labeled "Training Rewards" and ranges from 0.0 to 0.2 with tick marks at intervals of 0.1. In the top plot, titled "Easy Training Set", the blue line ("Llama-On-Policy-Easy") starts near 0.0 and rises to approximately 0.22 by 500 steps, with a shaded region indicating variability. The red line ("Llama-LUFFY-Easy") also starts near 0.0, rises to approximately 0.22 by 500 steps, and remains closely aligned with the blue line, showing similar variability. In the bottom plot, titled "Hard Training Set", the blue line ("Llama-On-Policy-Hard") starts near 0.0, rises slightly to approximately 0.05 by 100 steps, then declines sharply to near 0.0 by 200 steps and remains near 0.0 for the remainder of the steps. The red line ("Llama-LUFFY-Hard") starts near 0.0, rises to approximately 0.22 by 500 steps, and exhibits some variability, with its value fluctuating between approximately 0.15 and 0.22.
